subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 03/10] nfsdctl: share the listener nest parser

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors the listener parsing code in nfsdctl to share a common function for unpacking NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_ADDR nests. The original code had this logic duplicated in multiple places, which has been consolidated into a single function called parse_sock_nest(). This change improves code organization and reduces duplication, but does not introduce any functional changes.
